lastCompletedStory.title: Add the CLI-oracle rule to the curated oracle-authoring block in patterns.md

nextStoryContext: The curated CURATED BLOCK: oracle authoring rules in scripts/cam/patterns.md (starts line 1068) now carries a fifth numbered rule: a CLI-behavior oracle invokes `bun index.ts <sub>`, never `cam <sub>`, because `cam` resolves to the INSTALLED binary (almost always older than the change under test) and going red for that reason is a wrong-artifact failure, not a behavior failure. The rule carries the measured CAM-449 AC7 evidence verbatim (installed binary 0.262.0 returned a plannable set different from the working tree's) rather than an invented rationale, per the block's own rule 4 (evidence fidelity) applied reflexively. The block's preamble now says 'These five rules' (was 'these four'); the old literal phrase 'These four rules' no longer appears anywhere in the file. Rules 1-4 and their corollaries were left byte-for-byte untouched (append-and-amend-only convention); only the preamble sentence and the new rule-5 bullet were added. All three prose oracles (scoped sed+grep for rule 5 on its own physical line with `bun index.ts` literal, whole-file grep for the '0.262.0' evidence token, negative grep for the retired 'These four rules' phrase) were run verbatim against the draft before committing, per the repo's own backtick-breaks-literal-grep gotcha (CAM-449 US-003) -- confirmed neither of the new sentences code-formats a token in a way that splits a required literal span. Full bun run check:all spine (typecheck, 5763 tests, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet) passed clean, zero budget raises needed. This closes one of the four CAM-455 composite fix-sites (CAM-451); the other three (CAM-450 predicate restatements in cam-plan.md/CONTEXT.md, and the run.ts auto-chaining boot-prompt mismatch) are separate stories in this same PRD, not touched here.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure prose story: added one numbered rule plus a one-word preamble edit to an existing curated documentation block in scripts/cam/patterns.md. No external library, API surface, or production TypeScript code was touched.
